name: the questions compute and the questions verb
purpose: compute and print the persona question set.
responsibilities: src/query/questions.js exposes computeQuestions(readiness, { tree, ledgers, profileText, persona }). It reads levels.intentComplete.blockedBy for persona productOwner or personas.engineer.blockers for persona engineer, expands each blocker's failing items into one question each via a per-check template, orders them D1 then D2 then D4 then D7 then by source span, carries one writeBack entry per `when` case the template defines, groups by source span, and never creates or modifies a file under rcf/.

src/cli/questions.js registers `rcf define questions [--json] [--persona productOwner|engineer] [--stage <D|short>] [--limit <n>]`. Persona default comes from the profile register, else productOwner. Text mode prints groups and asks; --json emits the computeQuestions object. Exit 0 always; unknown persona exits 2 with usage naming productOwner and engineer. Writes nothing under rcf/.

src/mcp/tools.js adds `rcf_define_questions` (same object as the verb's --json), `rcf_define_readiness` (the readiness object), and `rcf_define_ledger` (thin wrapper over the ledger handler). All three share the envelope the existing query and write tools use.
internalStructure: computeQuestions is a pure function: it folds the readiness blockers into questions through a per-check template table, deterministically ids each question from (stage, check, itemId), carries writeBack commands verbatim, and groups by source span (the trailing `(source: path:line-span)` marker on brief statements, else `tree`). The CLI verb runs the same walkTree + loadAllLedgers + loadFreezeRecord + readProfileText path readiness.js uses, calls computeReadiness, then computeQuestions. The MCP tools reuse the handler shape of the existing query tools (walkTree, okResult, usageErrorResult).

interfaces.name: computeQuestions
interfaces.description: Compute the persona question set from a readiness result, a tree, the four ledgers and the profile text. Returns an object with treeHash, persona, level, ok, remaining, groups[], questions[], optional[] and engineer (collapsed count on the PO return).

interfaces.name: rcf define questions
interfaces.description: Print or JSON-emit the persona question set. --persona defaults to the profile register. --stage narrows to one stage; --limit caps the questions array. Writes nothing under rcf/.

interfaces.name: rcf_define_questions
interfaces.description: MCP tool: same structuredContent as the verb's --json output.

interfaces.name: rcf_define_ledger
interfaces.description: MCP tool: thin wrapper over the ledger handler, taking { name, verb, ...flags }.

notes: The viewer owns the Readiness tab PO-facing surface (viewer refresh PR 8); this TAC supplies only the data shape and the verb. Prompts and guidance land under TAC-4128.
